Dani Pedrosa rides Tesla's driverless Cybercab in Austin

Spanish rider Dani Pedrosa took a ride in Tesla's driverless Cybercab in Austin on Sunday, according to a video posted on social media by the rider's team, which showed the two-seat vehicle collecting him from a hotel without anyone behind the wheel.

Pedrosa, who is in Texas for a motorcycle event, said in the video that the trip across the city took about fifteen minutes and that he was surprised by how smoothly the vehicle handled traffic lights and pedestrians near the downtown area.

Tesla has not said when it will open Cybercab rides to the public in Austin, and the company did not respond to a request for comment on the video or on the status of its federal exemption request for vehicles without steering wheels or pedals.
